mapper.select: SELECT time_bucket('5 minutes', wp.time) AS time, wp.parameter_id AS parameterId, AVG(wp.value) AS value FROM waveform_parameter wp JOIN treatment_information t ON wp.treatment_information_id = t.treatment_information_id WHERE wp.treatment_information_id = #{treatmentInformationId} AND wp.time >= t.surgery_start_time AND wp.time <= t.recovery_end_time GROUP BY time_bucket('5 minutes', wp.time), wp.parameter_id ORDER BY time, parameterId
